title: Cyclooligosiloxanolate cluster complexes of transition metals and lanthanides

material_class.structural_family: sandwich-type cyclosiloxanolate cluster (type C) with encapsulated μ4-O2−

synthesis.procedure: Polyphenylsiloxane (4 g, 31 mmol as 'PhSiO2'), NaOH (0.69 g, 17 mmol) and 100 ml n-butanol were charged into a 1-l four-neck vessel with KPG stirrer, reflux condenser and thermometer. The mixture was stirred and refluxed (oil bath) for 1.5 h, cooled to 50–60 °C, then sodium metal (1.96 g, 9.4 mmol, small pieces) was added at once and the mixture was stirred and refluxed for an additional 1 h. Anhydrous GdCl3 (2.05 g, 7.8 mmol) in 120 ml n-butanol was added dropwise through the reflux condenser with continued stirring and reflux. After addition the mixture was refluxed 1 h more, cooled to room temperature and filtered to remove NaCl. The filtrate was evaporated to dryness under reduced pressure. The white residue was recrystallized from toluene/96% EtOH (2:1) to give a white crystalline product (1.81 g, 26%).
synthesis.temperature: reflux (oil bath); sodium addition at 50–60 °C; cool to room temperature after reaction
synthesis.time: 1.5 h initial reflux; 1 h after Na addition; 1 h reflux after GdCl3 addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 1-l four-neck reaction vessel with KPG stirrer, reflux condenser and thermometer; dropwise addition of GdCl3 through the condenser; filtration of NaCl; solvent removal at reduced pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filter off NaCl; evaporate filtrate to dryness under reduced pressure; recrystallize the white mass from toluene/96% EtOH (2:1)

properties.summary: No compound-specific magnetic or optical measurements are given for 16; room-temperature magnetism is discussed only for other (non-Gd) cyclosiloxanolate complexes. The recrystallized product is described as white.
